# Muhammad Awais Sattar — AI SaaS & Automation Developer

> AI SaaS engineer for service businesses. AI receptionists that never miss a call, automation pipelines that follow up automatically, and custom dashboards that run your operations — designed, built, and deployed.

## Services

- [AI Receptionist Systems](https://awaissattar-portfolio.vercel.app/#services): an AI front desk for local businesses that answers inquiries and follows up automatically.
- [CRM Setup & Automation](https://awaissattar-portfolio.vercel.app/#services): CRM pipelines that capture, qualify and follow up with leads automatically.
- [SaaS Admin Dashboards](https://awaissattar-portfolio.vercel.app/#services): custom dashboards that run your operations.
- [ERP & CRM Systems](https://awaissattar-portfolio.vercel.app/#services): full agency/business management systems — properties, leads, commissions, installments.
- [AI Integrations](https://awaissattar-portfolio.vercel.app/#services): AI features integrated into existing tools and workflows.
- [Automation Platforms](https://awaissattar-portfolio.vercel.app/#services): import-ready automation templates and end-to-end workflow builds.
- [Analytics Dashboards](https://awaissattar-portfolio.vercel.app/#services): reporting dashboards for business operations.
- [Custom Web Applications](https://awaissattar-portfolio.vercel.app/#services): designed, built, and deployed web applications.
